brand_identity.positioning: Premium Global Education + Career Counselling + Medical Career Guidance Brand for students, doctors, parents, and working professionals with focus on USA, Germany, Medical Careers (USMLE, Residency, Fellowships, Research), and International Career Advisory.
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Authoritative, trusted, global, warm, human, high-precision, editorial executive advisory.
anti_patterns: No cheap coaching institute look or overcrowded banner lists
No generic 'study abroad' template look with passport + airplane stock photos
No excessive, cheap full-screen gradients (#7351B7 or muddy dark gradients)
No Inter font for main headings; use Plus Jakarta Sans for Display and DM Sans for Body
No raw HTML selects or datepickers; use Shadcn Select and Calendar
No transparent background headers without blur

colors.usage_rules: Primary Blue (#0059A9) is dominant. Secondary Orange (#EB5F22) is used strictly as a kinetic accent for primary CTAs, active pills, badges, and key stats. Dark Navy (#00226B) for high-contrast hero panels and footers. Light background (#F6F9FC) for clean breathing room. Red is FORBIDDEN as a major color.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.15]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-navy leading-[1.2]

typography.marathi_adjustment: When Marathi language is active, increase line-height by 10-15% (leading-relaxed to leading-loose) and maintain font-weight at minimum 500 for crisp Devanagari rendering.

spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-xl (12px) for cards, rounded-full for pills and CTAs, rounded-2xl for hero feature panels

bilingual_support.routing: URL routing with /mr/ prefix for Marathi pages
bilingual_support.switcher_ui: Compact pill component 'EN | मराठी' in header, toggle switch in footer. Display 'मराठी' explicitly, never 'MR'.

navigation_and_header.header_style: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm transition-all duration-200
navigation_and_header.desktop_nav: Visible brand logo + main menu links (USA, Germany, Medical Careers, Career Counselling, About, Events, Blog) + Language Switcher ('EN | मराठी') + Primary CTA 'Book Free Counselling'
navigation_and_header.mobile_nav: Header logo + language switcher + hamburger drawer. Fixed bottom CTA bar with 'WhatsApp Us' + 'Book Counselling'
navigation_and_header.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right button (desktop) with pulse effect and quick chat tooltip.

homepage_structure: Sticky Header with Blur & Language Switcher
Hero Section (Split-screen or editorial grid with strong CTA 'Book Free Counselling' + 'Explore Programs')
Trust & Experience Banner (20+ Years, 10,000+ Students, 98% Visa Success)
Audience Pathway Selector (Student / Doctor / Parent / Working Professional)
Medical Career Pathways Visual Flow (MBBS → Profile → USMLE/Residency → Fellowship)
Astute Journey Timeline (01 Understand → 06 Progress with interactive steps)
Testimonials Carousel with Filter Tabs (Students / Doctors / Parents)
Global Education Partner Network (Grayscale logo wall of Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Johns Hopkins, TU Munich, Heidelberg, Charité, LMU, RWTH Aachen)
Free Assessments Trio Cards (Career Counselling, Profile Evaluation, USMLE Assessment)
Smart Multi-Step Lead Form (7 Steps Modal / Dedicated Section)
Dark Navy Footer with 4 Columns + Social Links + Language Toggle

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for subtle definition, shadow-xl for dynamic lift on card hover
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border border-white/40 for floating pills and modals
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer motion fade-up (y: 20 -> 0, duration: 0.4s), hover lift (-translate-y-1), step indicator highlight.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a modular, responsive React app for Astute Academy with bilingual EN/MR support. Build dedicated pages for Homepage, USA, Germany, Medical Careers, Career Counselling, About, Leadership, Testimonials, Blog, Events, FAQ, Contact, Program details, and Admin CMS. Ensure all buttons and interactive elements have data-testid. Use Plus Jakarta Sans & DM Sans for typography, Shadcn components for forms/dialogs/calendars/selects, and Sonner for toasts.
